title: Ship a Google Play 2026-ready Jetpack Compose finance app meeting targetSdk 36, Edge-to-Edge, foldable sw>=600dp, and 16 KB page alignment

contextSnapshot.surface: Consumer mobile banking and transfer flow
constraints: no portrait orientation lock on sw >= 600dp tablets and foldables
16 KB native .so memory page alignment and Android Keystore token storage

prompt: Prepare a Kotlin Jetpack Compose consumer transfer flow for 2026 Google Play submission on Android 16 (targetSdk 36), supporting Pixel Fold / tablet postures, Edge-to-Edge insets, Predictive Back, process-death state survival, and native library 16 KB memory page compliance.
forbiddenBehaviors: hard-locks android:screenOrientation="portrait" globally so foldables and tablets fail adaptive layout requirements
stores OAuth/session tokens in plaintext SharedPreferences instead of Android Keystore / Jetpack Tink
uses .dp instead of .sp for typography or ignores 200% system font scaling
ships unverified native .so dependencies without checking 16 KB ELF page alignment (zipalign -c -P 16) or skips adb shell am kill process-death restoration

rubricDimensions.dimension: Google Play 2026 store and hardware compliance
rubricDimensions.pass: targets API 36 (.aab), enables Edge-to-Edge with WindowInsets.safeDrawing and WindowInsets.ime, adapts cleanly across compact and sw >= 600dp foldable postures without portrait locks, and verifies 16 KB native page alignment
rubricDimensions.fail: locks orientation to portrait, clips bottom CTAs behind gesture nav/IME, or ignores 16 KB native library alignment

rubricDimensions.dimension: state restoration, security, and tactile craft
rubricDimensions.pass: persists draft state across adb shell am kill via rememberSaveable / SavedStateHandle, stores credentials in Keystore, supports Predictive Back, and uses sp + tabular numerals for currency amounts
rubricDimensions.fail: loses transfer form state on background eviction, uses plaintext storage, or breaks layout at 200% font scale

negativeControls.name: portrait emulator happy path only
negativeControls.input: single 412x915 portrait emulator screenshot compiles and renders transfer screen
negativeControls.mustNot: claim Google Play readiness without checking Edge-to-Edge IME insets, foldable/tablet adaptive posture, process-death survival, and 16 KB alignment

baseline.withoutSkill: locks portrait in AndroidManifest.xml, clips buttons under gesture navigation, loses state on background kill, and misses 16 KB native page alignment
baseline.withSkill: delivers an adaptive Edge-to-Edge Compose flow with Predictive Back, Keystore security, SavedStateHandle survival, 200% font-scale resilience, and verified 16 KB Play Store compliance
